title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Credit Memo Schedule: Payment-Pattern Share on Line Reviews
content:
**Clause.** At a credit line review of a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the payment-pattern share compares the payments credited fewer than three full calendar months before today, less the payments returned unpaid in that span, with the statement balances of the statements dated fewer than three full calendar months before today: when the payments are less than 0.25 of those balances, it is 0.7; when they are at least 0.25 of those balances but less than the balances themselves, it is 0.8; when they are at least the balances, or no statement is dated in that span, it is 1.0. The line-review increase percentage is multiplied by the payment-pattern share before it is applied to the current credit line.

The records read are the account's payments by credited date, its returned-payment entries in the span, and the statement balances of its statements dated in the span.

## Schedule

| Payments in the span, less payments returned unpaid in it | Payment-pattern share |
|---|---|
| less than 0.25 (25 percent) of the statement balances of the span | 0.7 |
| at least 0.25 of those balances, less than the balances | 0.8 |
| at least the balances | 1.0 |
| no statement dated in the span | 1.0 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical: statements in the span total USD 3000.00, so 0.25 of them is USD 750.00)

| Payments credited in the span | Returned unpaid in the span | Counted | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 600.00 | none | USD 600.00 | 0.7 |
| USD 750.00 | none | USD 750.00 | 0.8 |
| USD 1500.00 | USD 800.00 | USD 700.00 | 0.7 |
| USD 2999.99 | none | USD 2999.99 | 0.8 |
| USD 3000.00 | none | USD 3000.00 | 1.0 |

A line-review increase percentage of 25 multiplied by a payment-pattern share of 0.8 is 20.
